lessons.title: Branches of Government & Public Administration
lessons.teacher_notes: Examine public administration, legislative procedures, and register distinctions (civil servant vs bureaucrat vs official).

lessons.title: Advanced Modal Nuance & Past Deduction
grammar: Must have / Can't have / Might have + V3
Should have / Ought to have + V3
Bound to / Highly likely to + Verb
lessons.teacher_notes: Practice high-confidence past deduction and modal criticism of administrative/policy decisions.

lessons.title: Judicial Procedure & Corporate Compliance
lessons.teacher_notes: Discuss criminal/civil legal procedures, intellectual property rights, and corporate compliance standards.

lessons.title: Macroeconomics, Inflation & Global Trade
lessons.teacher_notes: Analyze central bank monetary policies, market fluctuations, global tariffs, and trade agreements.

lessons.title: Nominalization & Academic Register Shifts
grammar: Verbal active structure -> Nominalized noun phrase
lessons.teacher_notes: Transform active sentences into formal nominalized noun structures ('A thorough analysis of market data led to...').

lessons.title: Corporate Leadership & Market Segmentation
lessons.teacher_notes: Present strategic corporate visions, pitch for venture capital, and discuss customer retention strategies.

lessons.title: Empirical Methodology & Aerospace Tech
lessons.teacher_notes: Evaluate scientific double-blind study methodology, control groups, and aerospace engineering milestones.

lessons.title: Hedging, Nuance & Academic Stance Devices
grammar: Epistemic verbs (tend to, appear to, suggest that)
lessons.teacher_notes: Master cautious hedging devices in scientific claims ('The data would seem to indicate...').

lessons.title: Artificial Intelligence & Cybersecurity
lessons.teacher_notes: Debate predictive machine learning models, digital ethics frameworks, and cloud data security.

lessons.title: Investigative Journalism & Media Bias
lessons.teacher_notes: Explore press freedom protection, investigative journalism, and combating digital echo chambers.

lessons.title: Syntactic Inversion & Cleft Sentences
grammar: Negative adverb inversion (Rarely do we encounter...)
It-clefts & Wh-clefts (It was the CEO who approved...)
lessons.teacher_notes: Apply syntactic inversion and cleft structures for rhetorical emphasis in formal speeches and writing.

lessons.title: Cognitive Biases & Moral Logic
lessons.teacher_notes: Examine cognitive biases in decision making, emotional intelligence, and utilitarian ethics.

lessons.title: Circular Economy & International Relations
lessons.teacher_notes: Discuss circular economy models, urban sustainability plans, and multilateral diplomatic treaties.

lessons.title: Advanced Relative Clauses & Reporting Verbs
grammar: Impersonal passive reporting (It is alleged that...)
lessons.teacher_notes: Practice advanced relative pronouns, active/passive reduced clauses, and formal reporting verbs.

lessons.title: Higher Education & Rhetorical Public Speaking
lessons.teacher_notes: Deliver executive keynote speeches, use contrastive stress, and negotiate high-stakes deals.
